protocol.task: trajectory revision with shared frozen action predictor and shared trained revision adapter
protocol.fixed5: Post-acquisition candidate; 0.5s ADE/FDE over identical complete decisions. This candidate may not be executed by keep-plan policies.
protocol.retained_common: Actual retained plans scored on intersection of all policy plan masks and GT prefix masks. FDE horizon varies; it is not fixed5 FDE.
protocol.next_step: First endpoint of the actual plan at each 0.1s decision, using logged localization.

policies.learned: generate adapted candidate, then classify keep/replace
policies.no_refresh: retain until deadline; feasible adapted candidates are generated and counted each decision
policies.replan_only: generate and reject fresh candidates, then replan from stale memory each decision; both decodes counted
policies.fixed: full-BEV refresh at configured fixed interval plus deadlines
policies.random: seeded random trigger with configured probability plus deadlines
policies.all_fresh: generate and adopt adapted candidate each feasible decision
policies.oracle: offline same-state GT W decision only; nondeployable and not a global optimum
policies.all_fresh_base: disable latent adapter; adopt the frozen base predictor candidate each feasible decision
policies.no_refresh_base: disable latent adapter; adopt base candidates only at deadlines; all candidates are still counted

protocol.aggregation: Unique recording/timestamp anchors; equal-weight window means; positive improvement means learned is better.
protocol.inputs: Current full cached BEV is monitored by all policies; full evidence acquired under shared feasible deadline rule except stale-memory replan control.
protocol.limitations: Validation-set comparison; no independent-test or statistical-significance claim. Cached-BEV region counts measure acquisition proxy, not encoder latency or FLOPs.
protocol.cost_matching: Fixed interval/random probability require development calibration; not automatically cost matched.
protocol.timing: Decode-call counts include all candidates generated by the deployed policy, including rejected candidates; offline reference candidates excluded.
protocol.evidence_acquired: refresh_mask counts memory commits; candidate_evidence_reads counts fresh evidence used by all generated candidates
protocol.contribution: Unsuffixed policies share the trained adapter. The explicit _base controls disable it and share the frozen action predictor; compare all_fresh with all_fresh_base to isolate adaptation.
